<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Pak Punjab Tikka House</title>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Rozha+One&family=Hind:wght@400;500;600&display=swap">
<style>
:root{--green:#0F5B45;--green-dark:#0A4333;--gold:#F4A300;--red:#C62828;--paper:#FFF9EE;--ink:#241812}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;font-family:Hind,sans-serif;font-size:1.0625rem;color:var(--ink);background:var(--paper)}
a{color:inherit}
a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ink);outline-offset:3px}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:'Rozha One',serif;font-weight:400;margin:0}
.wrap{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}
.strip{height:14px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--red) 0 28px,var(--gold) 28px 56px,var(--green) 56px 84px)}

header{background:var(--green);color:#fff}
header .wrap{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;padding-top:18px;padding-bottom:18px}
.logo{font-family:'Rozha One',serif;font-size:1.5rem;text-decoration:none;color:var(--gold)}
nav{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:24px;font-weight:500}
nav a{text-decoration:none}
nav .call{background:var(--gold);color:var(--ink);padding:10px 20px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:600}

.hero{background:var(--green);color:#fff}
.hero .wrap{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:48px;padding-top:56px;padding-bottom:88px}
.hero-text{flex:1 1 440px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:22px}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(2.5rem,7vw,5rem);line-height:1.02;color:var(--gold)}
.hero p{margin:0;font-size:1.25rem;line-height:1.6;max-width:32rem}
.hero .tag{font-family:'Rozha One',serif;font-size:clamp(1.5rem,3.5vw,2.25rem);line-height:1.2;color:#fff}
.actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;margin-top:4px}
.btn{text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;padding:15px 30px;border-radius:999px}
.btn-gold{background:var(--gold);color:var(--ink)}
.btn-white{border:2px solid #fff;padding:13px 28px}
.frame{flex:1 1 320px;position:relative;padding:0;font:inherit;color:inherit;cursor:zoom-in;border:6px solid var(--gold);border-radius:16px;background:var(--green-dark);overflow:hidden;display:block;line-height:0}
.frame img{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
.frame p{margin:0;font-family:'Rozha One',serif;font-size:1.875rem;line-height:1.2;color:#fff}

#menu .wrap{padding-top:88px;padding-bottom:88px}
h2{font-size:clamp(2rem,4.5vw,3.25rem);color:var(--green)}
.sub{margin:10px 0 0;color:#5A4A3F;max-width:36rem;line-height:1.6}
.cols{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(300px,1fr));gap:56px;margin-top:48px}
h3{font-size:1.625rem;color:var(--red);margin-bottom:20px}
.item{margin-bottom:14px}
.cols h3:not(:first-child){margin-top:40px}
.row{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:10px}
.name{font-weight:600;font-size:1.1875rem}
.dots{flex:1;border-bottom:2px dotted #B8A794}
.price{font-weight:600;color:var(--green);white-space:nowrap}
.item p{margin:4px 0 0;color:#5A4A3F;line-height:1.5}

#order{background:var(--gold)}
#order .wrap{padding-top:72px;padding-bottom:72px}
#order h2{color:var(--ink)}
.ways{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:20px;margin-top:36px}
.way{background:var(--paper);border-radius:14px;padding:26px}
.way h3{font-size:1.375rem;color:var(--green);margin-bottom:8px}
.way p{margin:0;line-height:1.55}

#visit{background:var(--red);color:#fff}
#visit .wrap{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:36px;padding-top:72px;padding-bottom:72px}
#visit h2{color:#fff}
#visit p{margin:14px 0 0;font-size:1.1875rem;line-height:1.7}
#visit p a{font-weight:600;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:4px;display:inline-block;padding:6px 2px}
#visit .btn{background:#fff;color:var(--red);font-size:1.125rem;padding:17px 36px}

footer{background:var(--ink);color:#E6DACB}
footer .wrap{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding-top:24px;padding-bottom:24px;font-size:.9375rem}
footer strong{font-family:'Rozha One',serif;font-weight:400;color:var(--gold)}

.frame .hint{position:absolute;right:10px;bottom:10px;background:rgba(36,24,18,.85);color:#fff;font:600 .875rem/1.2 Hind,sans-serif;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:999px}
.lightbox{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:50;background:rgba(20,12,8,.95);display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.lightbox[hidden]{display:none}
.lb-close{align-self:flex-end;flex:none;margin:10px;width:48px;height:48px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;color:#241812;font-size:1.5rem;line-height:1;cursor:pointer}
.lb-scroll{flex:1;overflow:auto;padding:0 12px 16px}
.lb-scroll img{display:block;margin:0 auto;width:100%;max-width:1200px;height:auto;cursor:zoom-in}
.lb-scroll img.zoom{width:250%;max-width:none;cursor:zoom-out}
</style>
</head>
<body id="top">

<div class="strip"></div>
<header>
  <div class="wrap">
    <a class="logo" href="#top">Pak Punjab Tikka House</a>
    <nav>
      <a href="#menu">Menu</a>
      <a href="#visit">Order</a>
      <a class="call" href="#visit">Call us</a>
    </nav>
  </div>
</header>

<main>
  <section class="hero">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="hero-text">
        <h1>Pak Punjab Tikka House</h1>
        <p class="tag">Tikka, straight off the charcoal.</p>
        <p>Punjabi-style BBQ grilled fresh to order. Come hungry, eat with your hands, and bring the whole family.</p>
        <div class="actions">
          <a class="btn btn-gold" href="#visit">Order now</a>
          <a class="btn btn-white" href="#menu">See the menu</a>
        </div>
      </div>
      <button class="frame" type="button" id="menuPhoto" aria-label="Open the full menu photo"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64,
